# [CS030] Hardcoded Credential Check (auth-hardcoded-credential)

A password or token is compared with a constant in the code.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | CRITICAL |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html) |
| **OWASP** | A07:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A credential in the source cannot be rotated and is known to everyone who can read the code or the binary; it often acts as a backdoor.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
if r.Header.Get("X-Admin-Token") == "letmein" {
	grantAdmin(r)
}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(r.Header.Get("X-Admin-Token")), adminToken) == 1 {
	grantAdmin(r)
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [auth-hardcoded-credential]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    auth-hardcoded-credential: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore auth-hardcoded-credential -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** auth-hardcoded-credential
```
